capabilities: scan a folder for unquoted wikilinks in frontmatter keys
preview old and new lines for each match
add double quotes around checked link values
save a restore copy of each note before writing
export a repair report to a Markdown note (Pro)
disambiguation: It only quotes complete wikilinks in selected top-level frontmatter keys; it does not repair links in the note body or rebuild nested lists that the Properties view already rewrote.
extras: Freemium: presets and report export require a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship; free features need no account. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. After updates it opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). No in-plugin restore button; recovery is manual from .bak copies. README admits limited testing (mock vault, no real GitHub sign-in test, preview capped at 200 notes).
problem: Hand-written or imported frontmatter can contain wikilinks without quotes, which are invalid or ambiguous YAML, and fixing them across many notes by hand is slow and error-prone.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 total)

summary: Finds unquoted wikilinks in raw YAML frontmatter, previews each change, adds double quotes, and saves a restore copy before writing.
